changes.rationale: InstallEffects no longer exposes unconditional destination replacement or removal. One compare_exchange_installed primitive requires the expectation check and mutation to occur as an indivisible authorized effect and returns conflict without mutation on mismatch.
Install applies package bytes only through the plan's ExpectedPrior, while uninstall removes bytes only while the accepted installed package digest is current.

Automatic and explicit rollback restore prior bytes only while the installed candidate digest remains current; concurrent substitutions are preserved and return InstallConflict, while effect failure returns RollbackFailed.
Injected races cover absent and exact-prior states, automatic and explicit rollback, uninstall, special-file substitution, failed restoration, non-echo, and idempotent repeat use.
